blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Regional accent cues can be captured under matched conditions, but it remains unclear whether they persist between read and spontaneous speech. We study RVG1, with 500 German speakers from nine regions, comparing ten speech representations on regional classification and continuous geolocation under matched conditions and speaker-independent read–spontaneous transfer. Whisper performs best under matched conditions, reaching 0.489 nine-way UAR and 148 km median geolocation error, but drops to 0.11/0.18 UAR across transfer directions and 363 km geolocation error. Self-supervised models show a similar degradation, whereas speaker embeddings are less discriminative in-domain but more robust under transfer. This contrast is consistent across classification and geolocation. Across representations, robustness is associated with how little a representation shifts between styles (style-invariance), for which crossstyle speaker retrieval is an interpretable proxy. Age, sex, sentence-overlap, and duration controls do not account for the gap, although channel characteristics contribute. These results show that strong matched-condition performance does not indicate robust regional information.
blocks.zh: 在相应的条件下可以捕捉出区域口音提示,但尚不清楚它们是否在读和自发的语音之间持续存在. 我们研究RVG1, 有来自9个地区的500名德国人发言, Whisper在相匹配的条件下表现最好,达到0.489个九向UAR和148公里中位地位误差,但跨转移方向的UAR和363公里地位误差降至0.11.0.18. 自我监督的模型显示出类似的退化,而扬声器嵌入在域内较少具有歧视性,但在转移中更为有力。 这种对比在分类和地理位置上是一致的。 在各种表达方式中,稳健性与各种风格(风格-偏差)之间的表达方式相去甚远有关,对于这些风格,交叉式的扬声器检索是一种可解释的代名词. 年龄、性别、刑期重叠和持续时间控制并不说明存在差距,尽管频道特性有所贡献。 这些结果表明,有力的匹配业绩并不表明强有力的区域信息。

blocks.en: Regional variation affects pronunciation, prosody, and lexical choice, making geographic origin detectable and introducing variability in speech-processing systems. It has long been studied in dialectometry [ 23 ] and is relevant to forensic speaker profiling [ 14 ] and privacy-preserving speech processing [ 17 ] . Regional Variants of German 1 (RVG1) contains read and spontaneous speech from approx. 500 speakers across the German-speaking area (including Austrian, Swiss, and northern-Italian speakers) [ 3 ] . Earlier RVG1/j studies using GMM–UBM systems reached class-balanced accuracies of 35.3 % 35.3\% for nine regions and 56.0 % 56.0\% for three broad regions [ 9 ] , while phonotactic experiments reported a maximum accuracy of 19.2 % 19.2\% for nine spontaneous-speech dialects [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 区域变异影响发音、发音和词汇选择,使地理来源可以察觉,并在语音处理系统中引入变异性。 它长期以来在辩证法 [23] 中被研究过,与法医演讲者剖析 [14] 和保全隐私的语音处理 [17] 相关. 德语1(RVG1)的区域变体包含从相近处读取和自发的语音. 德语地区500名发言者(包括奥地利语、瑞士语和意大利北部发言者) [3]. 早期使用GMM-UBM系统的RVG1/j研究达到9个大区35.3%的分级平衡速率,而3个大区56.0%的分级平衡速率则达到56.0%. [9],而相声实验则报告9个自发相声方言的最大精度为19.2% 19.2%.

blocks.en:
Recent work uses pretrained speech representations for accent and dialect recognition. Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) models such as wav2vec 2.0, HuBERT, and WavLM provide general-purpose speech representations [ 2 , 13 , 4 ] , while XLSR and Whisper provide multilingual and large-scale ASR representations [ 6 , 18 ] . Multilingual SSL models have been adapted to language and dialect identification [ 19 ] and continuous and discrete SSLs explored for accent recognition [ 22 ] . Voxlect further evaluates speech foundation models for dialect and regional-language classification across languages, including German [ 11 ] .
It remains unclear whether regional information remains stable when speech changes from read to spontaneous. Linke et al. showed that speaking style can strongly structure SSL representations, with style similarity outweighing regional-variety similarity in some cases [ 16 ] . Geographic variation can also be modeled continuously through speech geolocation rather than predefined classes [ 12 , 15 ] .
blocks.zh:
最近的工作使用事先经过训练的语音表述来进行口音和方言识别. 由Wav2vec 2.0,HuBERT,WavLM等自行监督学习(SSL)模式提供通用语音表达[2,13,4],而XLSR和Whisper则提供多语种和大规模ASR表达[6,18]. 多语言 SSL模型已经适应了语言和方言的识别[19],并探索了连续和离散的SSL来识别口音[22]. Voxlect进一步评价了方言的语音基础模型和跨语言的区域语言分类,包括德语[11].
仍然不清楚的是,在语音从读取变为自发时,区域信息是否保持稳定。 林克等编. 这表明演讲风格可以强烈地构建SSL代表,其风格相似性在某些情况下超过了区域-多样性的相似性[16]. 地理变化也可以通过语音地理定位而不是预先定义的类来连续地进行模型化[12,15].

blocks.en:
However, strong performance when training and testing on the same speech type does not establish robustness under read–spontaneous transfer. Our contributions are:
(1) We introduce a controlled framework to evaluate whether regional information transfers between read and spontaneous speech, with speaker-independent evaluation under matched and mismatched conditions.
(2) We compare ten representations from seven model families for regional classification and continuous geolocation, complemented by analyses of regional granularity and potential confounds.
(3) We investigate style-invariance (how little a representation shifts between read and spontaneous speech) as a factor underlying robustness, relating cross-condition speaker retrieval and representation shift to classification and geolocation.
blocks.zh:
然而,当同一语音类型的培训和测试不能在读取/自发转接下建立稳健性时,表现良好。 我们的贡献是:
(1) 我们采用了一个控制框架,以评估区域信息在阅读和自发讲话之间是否转让,在相应和不匹配的条件下进行独立演讲者评价。
(2) 我们比较了7个示范家庭的10个陈述,以便进行区域分类和连续地理定位,并辅之以对区域颗粒性和潜在混乱的分析。
(3) 我们调查风格上的偏差(在阅读和自发发言之间,代表性的转变是多么之小),作为稳健性的一个根本因素,涉及跨条件的演讲者检索和代表性向分类和地理定位的转变。

blocks.en: Throughout the paper, we use regional accent for geographically conditioned variation in the speech signal.
blocks.zh: 在整篇论文中,我们使用区域口音来表示语音信号的地理条件变化。

blocks.en: 2 Data and Methods
blocks.zh: 2 数据和方法

blocks.en: Corpus and labels: RVG1-v3 provides 500 region-labelled German speakers with read speech, 498 of whom also have spontaneous recordings and 432 geocoded hometown coordinates; accordingly, classification uses 500 read and 498 spontaneous speakers, read–spontaneous analyses 498, and geolocation 432. The nine classes are imbalanced (speaker counts A–I: 44/103/31/73/53/63/20/13/100), motivating unweighted average recall (UAR) as the primary classification metric. We use the corpus taxonomy as the finest target (A: Low Franconian, B: West Low German, C: East Low German, D: West Central German, E: East Central German, F: Alemannic, G: East Franconian, H: South Franconian, I: Bavarian) and additionally consider six analysis-specific geographic classes ( { A , B } \{A,B\} , { C } \{C\} , { D } \{D\} , { E } \{E\} , { F , G , H } \{F,G,H\} , { I } \{I\} ), a 3-way partition { A , B , C } \{A,B,C\} , { D , E } \{D,E\} , and { F , G , H , I } \{F,G,H,I\} , and a 2-way Low- versus High-German partition following the Benrath-line division [ 24 ] . Region labels are treated as evaluation categories rather than sharp linguistic dialect boundaries. Read speech consists mainly of digit, number, and command strings plus phonetically balanced sentences, whereas spontaneous speech is a prompted monologue imagining an address to someone from the speaker’s home region; read–spontaneous transfer therefore also crosses a register boundary.
blocks.zh: Corpus和标签:RVG1-v3为500名带有区域标记的德语演讲者提供了读取的语音,其中498人还有自发录音和432个地理编码的家乡坐标;因此,分类使用500个读取和498个自发演讲者,读取自发分析498个,地理定位432个. 这9个类别是不平衡的(发言者计为A-I:44/103/31/73/53/63/20/13/100),促使未加权平均召回(UAR)作为主要分类指标。 我们把生物分类学作为最佳目标(A:Low Franconian,B:West Low German,C:East Low German,D:West Central German,E:East Central German,F:Alemanic,G:East Franconian,H:South Franconian,I:Bavarian),并额外考虑6个具体分析的地理类别({A,B·B·B·B·B·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克· 区域标签被视为评价类别,而不是尖锐的语言方言边界. 阅读语音主要由数字、数字和命令字符串组成,加上口头平衡的句子,而自发的语音则是一种诱导的独白,想象着一个来自演讲者家乡地区的某人的地址;因此,自发的传输也跨越了注册边界。

blocks.en:
Representations: We compare ten frozen speaker-level representations spanning seven families, evaluated for classification and geolocation, in-domain and cross-style: Whisper-large-v3 encoder features [ 18 ] (ASR); WavLM-large [ 4 ] , wav2vec 2.0-XLSR [ 2 , 6 ] , and HuBERT-large [ 13 ] (SSL); speaker embeddings, x-vector [ 20 ] and ECAPA-TDNN [ 8 ] (SpeechBrain spkrec-xvect-voxceleb , 512 512 -d, and spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb , 192 192 -d, both VoxCeleb-trained); a 97-dimensional PhonoQ phonological descriptor [ 1 ] ; eGeMAPS acoustic features [ 10 ] ; the 512 512 -dimensional continuous pre-quantization encoder latent of the Mimi audio codec [ 7 ] ( kyutai/mimi , 12.5 12.5 Hz frames); and the audio-encoder hidden states ( 1280 1280 -d) of the Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct audio LLM [ 5 ] . PhonoQ computes phoneme-posterior probabilities for 18 phonological classes and summarizes by maximum-posterior and log-likelihood-ratio statistics, average phone duration and its variability, and raw/normalized pairwise-variability (rPVI/nPVI) rhythm measures, aggregated to one vector per speaker; it is thus an interpretable phonological descriptor rather than a pretrained encoder.
We mean-pool encoder activations into one vector per speaker and use fixed layers selected by preliminary nine-way probing: Whisper L23, WavLM L24, wav2vec2-XLSR L10, and HuBERT L13.
A fully nested layer-selection check using an untuned logistic-regression probe gave similar 9-way UAR to the fixed-layer choice (mean 0.429 vs. 0.428 across encoders; Whisper 0.512 vs. 0.510), indicating that the fixed selection does not benefit from leakage.
Thus, we use the fixed-layer protocol throughout; these probe scores are not directly comparable to the tuned MLP results in Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh:
说明: 我们比较了涉及7个家庭的10个被冻结的演讲者级别陈述,对分类和地理位置、域内和跨类进行了评估: Whisper-gree-v3编码器特征[18](ASR);WavLM-group [4],wav2vec 2.0-XLSR [2,6],和HuBERT-group [13](SSL);扬声器嵌入,x-vector [20]和ECAPA-TDNN [8](SpeechBrain spkrec-xvect-voxceleb, 512-512-d;和Spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb,192-d,两者均为VoxCeleb-trained);97维的PhonoQ相声标 [1];eGeMAPAS相声标 [10];512-512维相声标连续预分化潜 [7](kyutai/mi, 12.5个Hz帧);以及Qwen2-A-A-B相声标 [1280-Acrut. PhonoQ计算出18个音响类的电话-前置概率,并通过最大前置和对数-相近-率统计、平均电话持续时间及其可变性、原始/正常的双相可变性(rPVI/nPVI)节奏测量法加以归纳,总合到每个扬声器一个矢量;因此,它是可解释的音响描述器,而不是预先训练的编码器。
我们是指集合编码器活化成每个扬声器一个向量,并使用由初步的九向探测选择的固定地层:Whisper L23,WavLM L24,wav2vec2-XLSR L10,和HuBERT L13.
使用未调节的物流回流探测器进行完全嵌入层选择的检查,给固定层选择提供了类似的9道UAR(平均0.429对0.428横跨编码器;Whisper 0.512对0.510),表明固定选择没有从泄漏中受益.

blocks.en:
Evaluation: We use five speaker-independent 70 : 30 70{:}30 train/test splits, fitting preprocessing on training only.
Classifier parameters are tuned by 3-fold cross-validation on the train split, with MLP hidden sizes of 128/256. 9-way representation differences are assessed with paired t-tests across the five matched splits and Holm–Bonferroni correction; because the five 70 : 30 70{:}30 splits overlap in speakers, these tests are treated as descriptive supporting evidence rather than exact inference.
blocks.zh:
评价: 我们使用5个扬声器独立70:30 70{:}30个列车/测试分机,只安装培训预处理。
分类参数由列车拆分上3倍的交叉验证调取,而MLP隐藏尺寸为128/256. 9道的表示差异通过5个配对的t测试和Holm-Bonferroni校正来评估;因为5个70:30 70{:}30个配对者重叠,这些测试被视为描述性佐证证据,而不是准确的推论.

blocks.en:
Controls and auxiliary tasks: We assess demographic confounding using age and sex alone, by adding them to the speech features, and by residualizing them from the representations. Microphone robustness is evaluated over the 4 × 4 4\times 4 train/test matrix. For geolocation, all representations use five speaker-disjoint splits with training-only preprocessing; high-dimensional features are reduced to 256 principal components
(via PCA, fit on training speakers) when needed. Coordinates are predicted with a two-layer MLP trained using great-circle loss and evaluated by median great-circle distance. Read–spontaneous transfer uses held-out speakers, with sentence-independent and duration-matched controls to test prompt overlap and speech-duration effects.
blocks.zh:
控制和辅助任务: 我们只用年龄和性别来评估人口结构的混乱情况,在讲话中增加这些特征,并从陈述中留下这些特征。 微机稳健性通过4×4 4\4次列车/测试矩阵评价. 就地理定位而言,所有代表都使用5个只进行培训预处理的讲演者离合分机;高维特性被减少到256个主要组件
(通过常设仲裁法院,适合培训演讲人)在需要时。 使用使用大圆圈损耗进行训练并用中位大圆圈相距评价的双层MLP来预测坐标. 阅读-自发转移使用被搁置的扬声器,有独立的句子和与长度相匹配的控制,以测试即时重叠和语音长度效应.

blocks.en:
Cross-style speaker retrieval: To measure preservation of speaker identity across style (read vs. spontaneous), we mean-pool representations within utterances and average them by speaker and style, yielding one ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized vector per speaker/style.
Each spontaneous-speech vector queries read-speech vectors by cosine similarity, with rank-1 accuracy given by the fraction whose nearest neighbor is the same speaker (498 queries; chance = 1/498 ≈ \approx 0.002).
No model is fit; speaker labels only define matches and score retrieval.
blocks.zh:
跨式扬声器检索 : 为了衡量不同风格(阅读与自发)的演讲者身份,我们指的是在演讲中集中表达,并按演讲者和风格进行平均表达,得出每个演讲者/风格的1 1 2\ell\2}——正常化矢量。
每个自发的相声向量查询通过相声相似来读取相声向量,其分数的精确度由最接近的邻居为同声的分数给出(498个查询;概率=1/498 ≈\\约0.02个).
没有模型适合;扬声器标签只定义匹配和分数检索.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Matched-condition regional discrimination
blocks.zh: 3.1 条件相匹配的区域歧视

blocks.en: Representation and granularity: Whisper ranks first at every granularity and the family-level ordering is preserved, although ranks below the top change across granularities (Tab. 1 ). Whisper reaches a 9-way UAR of 0.489 0.489 and a 3-way UAR of 0.767 0.767 . Its 9-way advantage is consistent across all five matched splits and all nine other representations (paired differences favoring Whisper on every split; treated as descriptive, see Sec. 2 ). Mean gains range from about 0.09 0.09 UAR over the strongest SSL representation to 0.27 0.27 over Mimi. Performance increases monotonically for all ten representations as the label space is coarsened. An untuned logistic-regression probe yields a very similar ordering, suggesting that the ranking is not driven by classifier tuning. Matched spontaneous-speech performance follows a similar ranking across granularities (Whisper 0.431 0.431 , 0.572 0.572 , 0.756 0.756 , 0.832 0.832 for 9-, 6-, 3-, and 2-way, respectively), indicating that the degradation in Fig. 3 b reflects read–spontaneous transfer rather than an inherent difficulty of spontaneous speech.
blocks.zh: 代表性和颗粒性: 耳语在每一颗粒中排行第一位,家庭级的订单保留下来,尽管在颗粒的上下位次变化(图1)。 Whisper达到9路的UAR为0.4890.489,3路的UAR为0.7670.767. 它的9个途径的优势在所有五个对应的分项和所有9个其他陈述中是一致的(在每次分项时偏好Whisper的矛盾;被视为描述性的,见第2节)。 平均收益范围从最强SSL代表的UAR比0.09 0.09到米米比0.270.27不等。 随着标签空间被收缩,所有十种表示的性能都单调地增加. 未调节的后勤后退探测器产生非常相近的订单,说明排名不是由分级器调取. 相匹配自发相声的性能在颗粒上也遵循了相类似的排名(Whisper 0.431-0.431;0.572-0.572;0.756-0.756;0.832-0.832为9-;6-;3-;2-向),表明Fig的降解. 3 b 反映的是自发转移,而不是自发发言的固有困难。

In-domain geolocation and regional structure: Whisper is the strongest matched-condition geolocation representation (Fig. 3 d), reaching 148 ± 16 148\pm 16 km ( ± \pm denotes the standard
deviation across the five splits) with a two-layer MLP trained using great-circle loss, compared with 175 175 km for direct coordinate regression and 242 242 km for the mean-location baseline. An auxiliary regional-classification head provides no further gain ( 148 148 km; p = 0.42 p=0.42 ). Region-level 9-way recall correlates strongly with class size (Spearman ρ = 0.87 \rho=0.87 , p = 0.003 p=0.003 ), ranging from 0.10 0.10 for South Franconian to 0.65 0.65 for Bavarian, while median geolocation error ranges from 116 116 to 208 208 km (Fig. 2 ). Leave-one-region-out errors show geographic structure, but because recall tracks class size, the maps are descriptive rather than evidence of differences in dialect difficulty.

blocks.en: Read–spontaneous degradation: Transfer performance varies strongly by representation family on both tasks (Fig. 3 ). For Whisper, 9-way UAR falls to 0.11 0.11 for read → \rightarrow spontaneous and 0.18 0.18 for spontaneous → \rightarrow read (Fig. 3 b), while geolocation error rises from 148 148 to 363 363 km (Fig. 3 d–e), exceeding the 242 242 km mean-location baseline. SSL encoders show similar degradation (wav2vec2-XLSR 0.14 0.14 / 0.19 0.19 UAR), whereas speaker embeddings and the codec retain more regional information (ECAPA 0.25 → 0.23 0.25\rightarrow 0.23 UAR, 196 → 208 196\rightarrow 208 km). Sentence-disjoint evaluation reduces Whisper 9-way UAR from about 0.48 0.48 to 0.40 0.40 (3-way 0.77 0.77 to 0.73 0.73 ), while duration matching leaves read UAR unchanged ( 0.486 → 0.488 0.486\rightarrow 0.488 ) and transfer near 0.11 0.11 . Thus, prompt overlap and speech amount alone do not explain the gap.

blocks.en:
Style invariance is associated with robustness. Rank-1 speaker retrieval between read and spontaneous speech is strongly associated with transfer performance across the ten representations: classification (Spearman ρ = + 0.74 \rho=+0.74 , p = 0.014 p=0.014 ; Fig. 3 c) and geolocation ( ρ = − 0.68 \rho=-0.68 , p = 0.030 p=0.030 ; Fig. 3 f). Speaker embeddings reach ≈ 0.99 \approx\!0.99 retrieval and the codec 0.72 0.72 , whereas content-oriented representations remain at ≤ 0.10 \leq 0.10 , suggesting that regional information is better retained when speaker-related information is preserved across conditions. For geolocation, lower in-domain error is also associated with higher transfer error ( ρ = − 0.71 \rho=-0.71 , p = 0.022 p=0.022 ), robust to leave-one-representation-out analysis and removal of both speaker embeddings. This trade-off is weaker for classification ( ρ = − 0.37 \rho=-0.37 , n.s.).
With only ten representations from partly related families, we treat all four correlations as exploratory: jointly, they do not survive Holm (smallest p = 0.014 > 0.05 / 4 p=0.014>0.05/4 ). The two central associations are stable under leave-one-representation-out ( ρ ∈ [ 0.64 , 0.81 ] \rho\in[0.64,0.81] for classification; ρ ∈ [ − 0.85 , − 0.64 ] \rho\in[-0.85,-0.64] for geolocation) but weaken to non-significance when both speaker embeddings are removed.
Moreover, auxiliary multi-task objectives did not significantly improve geolocation or transfer.

blocks.en: 3.3 Controls, confounds, and further analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 控制、混乱和进一步分析

blocks.en:
Age and sex alone yield 9-way UAR 0.141 0.141 , close to chance, and adding them to Whisper does not improve regional UAR ( 0.489 → 0.489 0.489\rightarrow 0.489 ). Residualizing age and sex from the features changes regional UAR by less than 0.02 0.02 , and regional performance remains well above chance within each sex (male 0.49 0.49 , female 0.43 0.43 ). At the same time, Whisper strongly encodes demographic information, reaching 0.99 0.99 balanced accuracy for sex and 4.4 4.4 -year age mean absolute error (MAE; against about 7 years for a constant predictor, since 66% of speakers are aged 21–30). The controls therefore support a limited conclusion: age and sex are encoded, but neither variable alone accounts for the observed regional discrimination.
Furthermore, averaged across mismatched microphone pairs, UAR remains above chance at 0.27 0.27 for 9-way and 0.60 0.60 for 3-way, but both are lower than the corresponding matched-microphone values of 0.36 0.36 and 0.68 0.68 . Channel characteristics therefore contribute to performance, even though regional information remains detectable under microphone mismatch.
blocks.zh:
年龄和性别本身就产生9向的UAR 0.41 0.41,接近机会,加上Whisper不会改善区域UAR(0.489 – 0.489 0.489\正中0.489)。 这些特征的残留年龄和性别使地区普遍居住状况变化不到0.02 0.02,地区表现仍然远远高于每个性别的机会(男性0.49 0.49,女性0.43 0.43)。 同时,Whisper强烈地将人口信息编码,性别的平衡准确度达到0.99 0.99,而4.4-年龄的绝对误差(MAE;恒定预测器大约为7年),因为66%的演讲者是21-30岁. 因此,这些控制支持一个有限的结论:年龄和性别被编码,但两个变量都无法单独说明观察到的区域歧视。
此外,平均跨相错配的麦克风对,9向0.27和3向0.60的UAR仍然高于机会,但两者都低于0.36 0.36和0.68 0.68的相应对应麦克风值。 因此,尽管在麦克风不匹配的情况下,区域信息仍然可以探测到,但信道特性有助于性能。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion & Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4. 讨论和结论

blocks.en:
The results distinguish matched-condition discriminability from robustness across read and spontaneous speech. Whisper performs best for regional classification and geolocation under matched conditions, and coarse 3-way structure is easier to recover than fine nine-region distinctions. Age and sex do not explain this performance, and regional information remains detectable under microphone mismatch, although channel effects remain.
The central finding is that read–spontaneous robustness is more closely associated with style-invariance (how little a representation shifts across styles, proxied by cross-style speaker retrieval) than with matched-condition strength. Whisper, the SSL models, and Qwen2-Audio perform strongly in-domain but degrade markedly under transfer, whereas speaker embeddings and, to a lesser extent, Mimi remain more stable. For geolocation, the strongest in-domain representations are also among the least robust. This complements prior work on pretrained representations for accent and dialect recognition [ 19 , 22 ] by linking robustness to style-invariance of the representation across speech conditions. These findings suggest that accent systems should be evaluated explicitly in both read and spontaneous speech, rather than relying solely on the performance of the matched-conditions. They also motivate future work on whether speaker-oriented representations retain geographic information relevant to anonymization. The study is limited to one imbalanced German corpus, and a broader validation will require additional datasets.
blocks.zh:
结果将相应条件的可歧视性与阅读和自发发言的强健性区分开来。 低声在相应条件下对区域分类和地理定位表现最好,粗细的3-道结构比细微的9个区域区别更容易恢复. 年龄和性别不能解释这种表现,区域信息在麦克风不匹配的情况下仍然能被察觉出,尽管频道效应仍然存在.
中心结论是,读取自发的强健性与风格上的偏差关系更紧密(一种代表性在风格上几乎没有变化,取自跨风格的扬声器),而不是具有相匹配的强度。 Whisper,SSL模型和Qune2-Audio在域内表现强劲,但在传输时明显退化,而扬声器嵌入,在较小的程度上,米米仍然比较稳定. 就地理位置而言,最强的域内代表也是最弱的。 这补充了以前关于口音和方言识别预先训练过的表述[19,22]的工作,将稳健性与各种语音条件的表述风格变化联系起来。 这些调查结果表明,口音系统应明确用读音和自发的语音加以评价,而不应仅仅依靠相应条件的性能。 它们还促使今后就面向发言者的表述是否保留与匿名有关的地理信息开展工作。 研究仅限于一个不平衡的德文体,更广泛的验证需要额外的数据集.

blocks.en: 5 Compliance with Ethical Standards
blocks.zh: 5 遵守道德标准

blocks.en: This study uses the pre-existing corpus; no new participants were recruited or data collected. The RVG1 corpus was used under the research-use terms of the Bavarian Archive for Speech Signals.
